none: PAS NLM-361F67: Early Medieval Cruciform Brooch
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy Brooch fragment. Cruciform Brooch foot fragment from the pelta shaped foot of a brooch featuring moulded scroll decoration either side of a curving central feature. These contribute to a visual pun depicting a face with nose and eyes. Incised lines on the back could be part of a runic inscription. Probably from a disturbed burial. Suggested date: Early Medieval, 550-600. Length:…
